R2R PostgreSQL.POSTGRES_DB: Database used by R2R for documents, chunks, vectors, files, users, and metadata.
R2R PostgreSQL.POSTGRES_USER: PostgreSQL role used only by the private R2R service.
R2R PostgreSQL.POSTGRES_PASSWORD: Generated PostgreSQL password shared with R2R through a service reference.
R2R PostgreSQL.PGDATA: PostgreSQL data directory beneath the Railway volume mount.

R2R Graph Clustering.PORT: Railway health-routing port for the private graph-clustering service.

R2R API.PORT: Railway HTTP routing port for the R2R API.
R2R API.R2R_HOST: Network interface on which R2R accepts requests.
R2R API.R2R_PROJECT_NAME: PostgreSQL schema namespace used by this R2R deployment.
R2R API.R2R_SECRET_KEY: Generated signing key for R2R authentication tokens.
R2R API.R2R_ADMIN_EMAIL: Initial administrator email used to sign in to the dashboard and API.
R2R API.R2R_ADMIN_PASSWORD: Generated initial administrator password; read it from this service after deployment.
R2R API.R2R_POSTGRES_HOST: Private Railway hostname of the PostgreSQL service.
R2R API.R2R_POSTGRES_PASSWORD: Database password referenced from PostgreSQL and redacted from R2R startup logs.
R2R API.R2R_POSTGRES_MAX_CONNECTIONS: R2R database pool ceiling for this single-replica topology.
R2R API.R2R_POSTGRES_STATEMENT_CACHE_SIZE: Prepared-statement cache size per R2R database connection.
R2R API.OPENAI_API_KEY: Required OpenAI API key for embeddings, ingestion summaries, retrieval, and RAG answers.
R2R API.OPENAI_API_BASE: Optional OpenAI-compatible base URL used by LiteLLM embeddings; leave blank for OpenAI.
R2R API.OPENAI_BASE_URL: Optional OpenAI-compatible base URL used by the OpenAI completion client; keep aligned with OPENAI_API_BASE.
R2R API.HATCHET_CLIENT_TLS_STRATEGY: Compatibility setting for R2R's simple local orchestration mode.

R2R Dashboard.PORT: Railway HTTP routing port for the dashboard.
R2R Dashboard.NEXT_PUBLIC_R2R_DEPLOYMENT_URL: Public HTTPS URL of the R2R API used by browser clients.
R2R Dashboard.NEXT_PUBLIC_R2R_DEFAULT_EMAIL: Non-secret administrator email shown by the dashboard login form.
R2R Dashboard.NEXT_PUBLIC_R2R_DEFAULT_PASSWORD: Intentionally blank because NEXT_PUBLIC values are visible to every browser.
R2R Dashboard.R2R_DASHBOARD_DISABLE_TELEMETRY: Disables dashboard telemetry for this self-hosted deployment.
